name: Srinidhi Shetty
bio:
Srinidhi Ramesh Shetty (born 21 October 1992) is an Indian actress, model, and beauty pageant titleholder who works predominantly in Kannada, Telugu, and Tamil cinema. She won the Miss Diva Supranational 2016 title and represented India at the Miss Supranational 2016 pageant in Poland, where she won the title.

Shetty made her feature-film debut as Reena Desai opposite Yash in Prashanth Neel's period action film *K.G.F: Chapter 1* (2018), earning nominations for the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut – South and the SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Kannada. In 2022, she reprised the role in *K.G.F: Chapter 2* and won the SIIMA Award for Best Actress – Kannada. The same year, she made her Tamil debut as criminology professor Bhavana Menon in R. Ajay Gnanamuthu's psychological action thriller *Cobra* (2022), opposite Vikram.

Shetty made her Telugu debut as ASP Mrudula IPS in Sailesh Kolanu's investigative action thriller *HIT: The Third Case* (2025), opposite Nani. She also appeared as Dr. Raaga Kumar in Neeraja Kona's romantic drama *Telusu Kada* (2025), alongside Siddhu Jonnalagadda. Her other film credits include the Telugu family drama *Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47* (*AK47*, 2026).
